To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a system has been developed to translate high-level product assembly and disassembly design instructions into low-level assembly instructions for manufacturing and disassembly instructions for demanufacturing.

the developed system can automatically generate low-level assembly and/or disassembly instructions from high-level instructions and that it can automatically evaluate the cost of assembly and disassembly of parts.

we have developed a set of rules that can be used for automatically converting high-level product design instructions into low-level assembly/disassembly instructions for a generic assembly and/or disassembly model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a method that can be used to automatically generate assembly/disassembly instructions.
developing a system for evaluating products for their ease of assembly and disassembly, and for their recyclability.
a method for evaluating products in the design stage, based on the assembly and disassembly costs of the parts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a generic assembly and/or disassembly model has been developed and a set of rules has been developed for translating high-level design instructions into low-level assembly instructions.
the system developed in this work is capable of generating a set of assembly and disassembly sequences from high-level product design information.
this paper provides an effective method for translating design information into assembly and disassembly information.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a system for evaluating products during their design stage has been developed.
we have developed a system for evaluating product design from a manufacturing perspective.
we are developing an integrated system for evaluating product assembly and disassembly costs in their design phase.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to automate the process of evaluating assembly and disassembly cost for a product.
the system can help designers to evaluate product designs in their early design phase.
the developed system is able to generate assembly and disassembly plans for products.
